stance_basis: recommends preservation of two areas or relocation of rare plants, implying conditional acceptance of project
summary: The Highlands Biological Station conducted a survey of gorges near the Bad Creek Project and identified two biologically unique locations warranting protection: the west fork of Howard Creek and a ridge supporting a rare stand of Fothergilla major. The Station recommended preservation of these two areas or, at minimum, relocation of some Fothergilla plants, suggesting conditional acceptance of the project provided these natural resources are protected. The Applicant responded by transplanting 26 Fothergilla specimens out of the project area.
complaint_summary: The Highlands Biological Station recommended preservation of two biologically unique areas (west fork of Howard Creek and a Fothergilla major ridge) within the proposed project area, or at least relocation of some Fothergilla plants, due to their rare and unique biotic character.
